'''Bili''' is a [[bouncer]] at an inn called [[Easing the Badger]] in [[Illian]]. His aunt is named [[Nieda Sidoro]].

==Appearance==
Bili is a very large man, bigger than [[Perrin Aybara]].{{ref/book|3|42}} He can carry a man in either hand out of the inn.{{ref/book|2|9}}

==Activities==
Bili sees [[Bayle Domon]] at the inn when the ship captain visits.{{ref/book|2|9}} When [[Shadowspawn#Grey men|Gray Men]] attack the inn, Perrin, [[Lan Mandragoran]], [[Moiraine Damodred]], [[Faile Bashere]], and [[Loial]] kill them before Bili has time to react.{{ref/book|3|42}} Bili is told by his aunt to haul the bodies of the Gray Men out of the common room and lay down clean sawdust.
